slru.label: SLRU
slru.note: Copies used at least twice evicted after others; LRU within tiers.

last-gap.label: Last gap
last-gap.note: Protect until now + this session's last observed pause.

global-median.label: Global median
global-median.note: Protect until now + median observed pause (log-binned).

continuum-ttl.label: Continuum TTL
continuum-ttl.note: argmax_t P(pause<=t)*reload(context) - t over observed pauses; retention only, soft protection.

oracle.label: Oracle (bound)
oracle.note: Protect until the recorded next arrival plus slack; uses future data.

unbounded.label: Unbounded cache (bound)
unbounded.note: LRU with enough capacity that nothing is evicted.

served_model.name: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M
served_model.note: Sets KV capacity only; timing is the pinned uncalibrated polynomial model.

calibration.method: single cold request per size, TTFT under the frozen engine settings
